G421722.description: Mabanda is a city located close to the southern tip of Burundi, near the border with Tanzania.

G421930.description: Vyanda is a town and seat of the Commune of Vyanda in Bururi Province in southern Burundi. It has a population of 29,685 and by road it is located 34.9 kilometres southeast of Bururi and 13.2 kilometres northeast of Kigwena.

G422232.description: Makamba is a city located in southern Burundi. It is the capital city of Makamba Province.

G423328.description: Bururi is a city located in southern Burundi. It is the capital city of Bururi Province and has around 20,000 inhabitants in 2007.

G423549.description: Rumonge is the capital city of Rumonge Province, Burundi, and a port on the shores of Lake Tanganyika. It is a significant transit point on the lake for trade into Burundi and other parts of East Africa.

G423794.description: Mwaro is a city located in central Burundi. It is the capital city of Mwaro Province.

G425309.description: Gatumba is a village in western Burundi, near the border with the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The place is known for a massacre that took place at Gatumba refugee camp connected to the village.

G425378.description: Bujumbura (French pronunciation: [buʒumbuʁa]; Kirundi pronunciation: [buʒuᵐbuɾa]), formerly Usumbura, is the economic capital, former political capital, largest city and main port of Burundi. It ships most of the country's chief export, coffee, as well as cotton and tin ore.

G425551.description: Muramvya is a city located in central Burundi. It is the capital city of Muramvya Province.

G426272.description: Gitega (French pronunciation: [ɡiteɡa]), formerly Kitega, is the political capital of Burundi. Located in the centre of the country, in the Burundian central plateau roughly 62 kilometres (39 mi) east of Bujumbura, the largest city and former political capital, Gitega is the country's fourth largest city and former royal capital of the Kingdom of Burundi until its abolition in 1966.

G426423.description: Zanandore is a town located in Karuzi Province, Burundi, Africa. It falls within the second-order administrative district of Nyabikere.

G426700.description: Ruyigi is a city located in eastern Burundi. It is the capital city of Ruyigi Province.

G427701.description: Cankuzo is a city located in eastern Burundi. It is the capital city of Cankuzo Province.

G428219.description: Karuzi, or Karusi, is a city located in eastern Burundi. It is the capital city of Karuzi Province.

G428515.description: Bubanza is a city located in northwestern Burundi. It is the capital city of Bubanza Province.

G428632.description: Mpanda is a commune of Bubanza Province in north-western Burundi. The capital lies at Mpanda city.

G430021.description: Cibitoke is a city located in northwestern Burundi, near the border of Democratic Republic of the Congo. It is the capital of the Cibitoke Province.

G430569.description: Ngozi is a town located in northern Burundi. It is the largest urban center in the Ngozi Province and the location of the provincial headquarters.

G430952.description: Kayanza is a city located in northern Burundi, known for its tea and coffee production. It is the capital city of Kayanza Province, subdivided into nine communes from which one is called Kayanza.

G431748.description: Muyinga is a city located in northern Burundi. It was the capital city of the former Muyinga Province.

G432456.description: Kirundo is a city located in northern Burundi. It is the capital city of Kirundo Province and seat of the Commune of Kirundo.

G433635.description: Rutana is a town in southern Burundi. It lies west of Mount Kikizi, one of the highest mountains in the nation.
